name: Viometeo Weather Health
author: viometeo

sections.description:
Viometeo™ is a planetary biometeorological intelligence platform. It answers the daily physiological question citizens ask every morning: “How will I feel tomorrow?”

Traditional weather widgets only show standard temperature and sky conditions. Viometeo bridges atmospheric science and human physiology by computing real-time environmental strain indices for 12 human biological systems—including barometric pressure fluctuations, joint stiffness indicators, respiratory dust/smoke, and seasonal pollen loads.

Designed for US newsrooms, local community publishers, chronic health advocates, and outdoor blogs, Viometeo renders an interactive 425px widget inside a lazy-loaded sandbox iframe without loading CSS or JavaScript bundles onto your site’s frontend.

Features for Publishers & Webmasters:

  • Compact 425px Widget: Designed specifically to fit cleanly inside sidebars, article bodies, and footer areas.
  • Lightweight Iframe Delivery: Does not enqueue bulky CSS or JavaScript files on your site’s frontend.
  • US Standard Defaults (Light-First): Clean Slate Light theme by default, with native support for US Imperial units (°F, mph, inHg, inches) alongside international Metric standards.
  • 12 Environmental Health Strain Indicators: Evaluates Barometric Migraine, Respiratory/Dust, Arthritis, Seasonal Pollen, Extreme Thermal Strain, UV Radiance, Sleep Quality, TEWL Skin Barrier, and Circadian/SAD factors.
  • Hyperlocal Targeting: Supports 95+ global metros and 35+ major US metropolitan hubs (New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Miami, Houston, Boston, Phoenix, Seattle, and more) with location detection fallback.
  • Publisher Co-Branding: Optionally append your publication’s name (e.g., YourBrand ✕ VIOMETEO™) directly within the widget header.
  • Environmental Telemetry Only: Pure atmospheric telemetry. Zero clinical diagnosis and zero pharmaceutical endorsements.

External Service & Data Transparency (Guideline 6 Compliance)

This plugin connects to and relies upon the Viometeo™ Cloud Telemetry Engine hosted at viometeo.com to provide real-time atmospheric and biometeorological calculations.

  • Service Provided: Delivers a responsive visual 425px iframe widget displaying aggregated planetary atmospheric metrics (pressure gradients, temperature, air quality, humidity).
  • Data Transmitted: To deliver localized forecasts, the plugin transmits public, non-personal parameters: target city slug, selected color theme (dark/light), measurement unit system (imperial/metric), interface language, and optional partner display name.
  • Privacy & Security: No personal user data, cookies, email addresses, or IP addresses are stored or harvested by the external service.
  • Terms of Service: https://viometeo.com/about.php
  • Privacy Policy: https://viometeo.com/about.php
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. In your WordPress Admin Dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. In the search box, type Viometeo.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. Go to Settings > Viometeo™ Weather to configure your default city, interface theme, and measurement units (°F / °C).

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip archive.
  2. In your WordPress Admin Dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Adding the Widget to Your Site

  • Sidebar / In-Article Widget: Insert [viometeo] anywhere on your site.
  • Custom Shortcode Example:
    [viometeo city=”chicago” units=”imperial” theme=”light” partner=”Midwest Chronicle”]
  • Using Classic Widget: Go to Appearance > Widgets, drag the Viometeo™ Health Weather Widget into your desired Sidebar or Footer area.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site’s loading speed?

No. Viometeo does not enqueue external CSS or JavaScript libraries on your frontend. The widget operates inside a lazy-loaded sandbox iframe.

Does Viometeo provide medical diagnoses?

No. Viometeo strictly calculates measurable atmospheric and environmental forces (barometric pressure drop $\Delta P$, particulate matter PM2.5/PM10, dew point, solar radiation). It provides environmental intelligence, never clinical diagnosis or medical prescriptions.

Can I use Imperial units (°F, mph, inHg) for US audiences?

Yes. Imperial units are enabled by default for US-centric installations, and you can switch between Imperial and Metric in the Settings panel or directly in the shortcode attributes.

Can I customize the widget with my site’s name?

Yes. Use the partner parameter in the shortcode (e.g., [viometeo partner="Boston Gazette"]) or fill in the Publisher Co-Branding field in Settings > Viometeo™ Weather.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Updated default interface to Clean Slate Light for broad news portal compatibility.
  • Added strict Referrer Policy attribute for secure iframe embedding.
  • Added 100+ metropolitan hubs autocomplete list in Admin Settings.
  • Properly enqueued admin helper scripts via WordPress standards.

1.0.0

  • Initial official release for WordPress.org repository.
  • Universal Imperial (°F, mph, inHg) & Metric (°C, km/h, hPa) dynamic conversion support.
  • 12 Biometeorological physiological strain indicators.
  • Edge-cached 425px iframe embedding architecture.
  • Publisher co-branding integration.
